scope: The runtime-link conditions that remain after the twenty-seven profile and operation cells: three gate conditions, the malformed branch of each profile, four central closure conditions and the independent Assurance. For each one this document names the four kinds of evidence a closure needs, the prepared inputs in this directory, the acceptance criteria and the findings that block a closure today.

evidenceKinds.sourceConsumer: the final source check, write, route or receipt computation that consumes the condition
evidenceKinds.positiveActivation: a final-target witness in which the premise and the consumer actually execute
evidenceKinds.consumerRemovalNegative: removing or weakening the consumer makes the same claim fail
evidenceKinds.compiledConsumer: the compiled runtime or a downstream product consumer actually consumes the condition

conditions.condition: Every accepted rejection or operational failure returns a typed failure whose report, read by the fixed ABI reading of its selector, is bound to the decoded command and to the sender; a malformed or dependency revert carries no typed payload.

conditions.condition: Abstract allowed behavior is preserved by the final code, and every concrete success reflects an abstract behavior or is covered by an exact non-claim.

conditions.condition: Every public, external, inherited, governance and profile entrypoint of every profile runtime belongs to an abstract operation or to an explicit path outside the runtime-link relation.

findings.summary: The runtime evaluates the domain and identifier rules, and by source order further kernel rules, before it validates every bounded word. Calldata that the formal decoder classifies as malformed can therefore end in a typed failure. The concrete probe observed a typed failure for every ordering recipe on all three profiles: a foreign domain returns the invalid-command failure with the domain reason, a stale identifier returns it with the identifier reason. No external call, log or committed write occurred. Under the current decoder no abstraction satisfies the bound relation for such an execution.
findings.decisionNeeded: Before malformed certificates are built, the closure has to choose between validating every bounded word before the first kernel rule, which changes every runtime identity and the evidence bound to it, and modeling the actual check order in the decoder and in the malformed branch.

findings.summary: Canonical calldata sent with a nonzero call value reverts with an empty payload on every typed entrypoint, while the decoder yields a typed command for it.
findings.decisionNeeded: The accepted set has to exclude nonzero call values, or the model has to classify them.

findings.summary: The executed code is recorded for one certificate per profile at most; most certificate records name no program identity.
findings.decisionNeeded: Each certificate needs the code it executed, bound to the profile template by the exact matching rule.

findings.summary: The Hook runtimes have no normative route classes, so every state-changing Hook selector is unclassified, including the two typed command entrypoints of the Hook adapter.
findings.decisionNeeded: Normative classes for the Hook runtimes, including classes for the balance-change callback, the fresh seal, the compliance module and the factory.

findings.summary: Some storage variables that no abstract field reads have no runtime-only reason in the earlier central closure, among them the pending commitment and reversal records of the Native runtime and the topology fields of both governors.
findings.decisionNeeded: A reason or an abstract counterpart for each of them.

findings.summary: The formal model reads storage through runtime manifest projections that are locale parameters; no per-profile manifest instance exists.
findings.decisionNeeded: A formal reader per profile manifest, checked against the crosswalk.

nonclaim: Preparation only. This document describes inputs, checks and acceptance criteria for conditions that remain open. It does not discharge a runtime-link cell, the malformed branch, the acceptance partition, the central refinement closure or the independent Assurance, and it does not authorize a merge, a release or a deployment.
